about: The fields of the payloads the web is served (craft page, category page and list, catalogue, compare, explainer) that no golden in shared/ carries yet, as found on 2026-11-23 (decision 0151), leaving out what the web never parses: the craft page's chapters, which it drops (decision 0162), and the block kinds a served explainer refuses as not built (decision 0168). tests/contracts/test_golden_fields.py fails when a field is unshown and not listed here, so a field the backend adds reaches a golden in the same change, and when a listed field is shown or gone, so this list only shrinks. docs/TECH_DEBT.md, Goldens that do not yet show every field, says what clears it.
